kept.spine: The Elected Reeve is tolerated and not backed, and a hard decision here would have to be paid for out of an empty purse.
The weekly market fills and the quarry has work, and the Elected Reeve stands on that and on little else.
Hochhausen treats the Elected Reeve as settled in the seat, and business here is done on that footing.
Nothing here governs cleanly, and the Elected Reeve decides at the pace of whichever of the Craft Guilds, the Merchant Guilds and the Religious Authorities is least willing.

kept.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
kept.spine: The village reeve governs here under the title Elected Reeve, and the name is exact about the size of the place in a way strangers regularly mistake.
Some in the village would take the seat from the Elected Reeve if they could, and they cannot, and everybody involved understands the position exactly.

kept.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public opinion neither helps nor hurts
kept.spine: Opinion in the village runs neither for the Elected Reeve nor against it, and the seat governs on its own strength.
